edges.text: 60 credits of which 15 credits in mathematics and 15 credits in computer science. Probability and Statistics or Probability and Statistics DV. Algebra and Geometry or Linear Algebra and Geometry I. Participation in a second course in programming.
Participation in Program Design and Data Structures, of which 9 credits must have been completed.

60 credits of which 15 credits in mathematics and 25 credits in computer science. Alternatively 45 credits in the Master's Programme in Language Technology. Participation in Program Design and Data Structures of which 9 credits shall be completed, alternatively participation in Algorithms and Data Structures I. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
60 credits in mathematics or computer science. Participation in discrete mathematics (for instance Algebra I), algorithms and data structures, and a second course in programming.
60 credits in mathematics and computer science, including Algebra I, Logic and Proof Techniques I, a second programming course and programming in at least one functional and one imperative language.
60 credits including 15 credits in mathematics and 30 credits in computer science, including Operating Systems and a second course in computer programming.

120 credits including 30 credits in mathematics including an introduction to linear algebra (Linear Algebra and Geometry I or the equivalent) and basic logic (Algebra I, Basic Course in Mathematics, or the equivalent), and 45 credits in computer science. Participation in Algorithms and Data Structures II. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
15 credits in mathematics and 30 credits in computer science, including at least one second course in computer programming and at least 5 credits in computer architecture.

120 credits including 15 credits in mathematics and 30 credits in computer science or technology. 10 credits in programming. Participation in Distributed Information Systems or Computer Networks I. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits including a second course in programming, Algorithms and Data Structures I, Algebra I and linear algebra. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits including 60 credits in computer science, including programming in C and a second course in computer programming. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
120 credits including 90 credits in computer science and mathematics with participation in Computer Networks I. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
150 credits including 75 credits in computer science, including 15 credits at G2F-level or higher, and 20 credits in mathematics. Admission requires a project plan accepted by the department.

Participation in one of the courses Basic Course in Mathematics, Basic Algebra, Algebra and Vector Geometry, Basic Algebra or Algebra and Geometry. The course can be taken in parallel with one of these courses.
Participation in Single Variable Calculus or Calculus for Engineers. Participation in Linear Algebra I, Algebra and Geometry or Algebra and Vector Geometry.
5 credits in mathematics. Participation in Single Variable Calculus or Single Variable Calculus M and in Linear Algebra I or Algebra and Geometry.

Alternative 1: 3 credits in mathematics. Participation in Single Variable Calculus, Single Variable Calculus M or Calculus in One Variable. Participation in Linear Algebra I or Algebra and Geometry. General entry requirements and Mathematics Further level 2, or Mathematics 4/Mathematics D
Participation in Basic Course in Mathematics or Basic Algebra.

120 credits including 45 credits in IT-related fields of study, including human-computer interaction, or the equivalent. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
120 credits. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering including 50 credits in computer science and mathematics, of which at least 20 credits in computer science and 20 credits in mathematics. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

60 credits including Algebra and Geometry/Linear Algebra and Geometry I/Linear algebra I. Participation in a programming course in Python (for example Computer Programming I). 60 credits including Program Design and Data Structures. Linear Algebra and Geometry. Single Variable Calculus. Participation in Probability and Statistics DV.
